project.name: Hot Wheels News Bot
project.description: A production Python news pipeline that collects Hot Wheels articles, filters and deduplicates them, queues accepted items, transcreates them into Russian, and publishes them on a fixed schedule.

milestone.title: Hot Wheels News Bot product roadmap
milestone.goal: Operate a reliable autonomous Hot Wheels news service while completing the remaining precision, safety, observability, and product-expansion work.
